server.name: io.github.jsgorana/ignition-mcp
server.description: MCP server for Inductive Automation Ignition: tags, alarms, history, and Perspective
server.title: Ignition MCP

environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8088
environmentVariables.name: IGNITION_URL

environmentVariables.description: Ignition API key in 'name:secret' form
environmentVariables.name: IGNITION_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: HMAC secret shared with the mcp-bridge WebDev project; enables live tag/alarm/history/Perspective tools
environmentVariables.name: IGNITION_BRIDGE_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable mutating tools (each call still requires confirm=true)
environmentVariables.name: IGNITION_ALLOW_WRITES
